text:
Priya: Weekend poll  what's everyone doing Sat/Sun? Beach or art crawl?
Ken: Beach! Surfboard ready. :surfing_man: Low tide morning looks great.
Rosa: Art crawl for me  got tickets to a small gallery opening on Saturday evening.
Devon: Leaning beach but can switch if rain. Also might run a 5k Sunday morning.
Priya: Weather link: `Sat: 72F sunny; Sun: 59F chance of showers` 
Ken: If anyone wants a low-key bonfire Sat night I'm bringing marshmallows.
Rosa: I will bring a portable speaker if we're doing beach. Also sunscreen.
Devon: Note: I'm allergic to shellfish so will avoid seafood spots.
Priya: Calendar-Bot, can you check public events and avoid clashing with the city parade?
Calendar-Bot: Flag: City parade on Sunday 10:30-12:00 downtown  may affect transit.
Ken: Good call. Beach it is if transit is messy.
Rosa: OK I'll do art another weekend then. Enjoy the bonfire if you go!
Devon: Vote: :one: beach, :two: art crawl. My vote :one:.
Priya: :one: Beach. Group consensus looks beachy. I'll text details later.
Ken: I'll pack the cooler. Who wants hot chocolate for afterward? :hot_chocolate:
Priya: Me!
Rosa: Have fun y'all :wave:
